title: Bonds Bite Back
summary: Earlier this morning, stocks were poised to put in a performance that would be similar to yesterday's, when the S&P 500 (SPX) was almost perfectly unchanged even as tech stocks pulled the Nasdaq 100 (NDX) higher. A dose of further consolidation or some modest profit-taking seemed to be in order. Bond traders had other plans, though, and a sharp jump in yields put a damper on equities.
